summary: Established and reboot-verified an AIDE integrity baseline for `/etc` on node1. It tracks 1,703 entries and runs daily through a persistent systemd timer.
actions_performed: Installed and configured AIDE with metadata, ACL, extended-attribute, and cryptographic-hash checks.
Created a root-owned mode-0600 reference database.
Enabled a daily persistent integrity-check timer.
Proved detection using a reversible test file, then restored a clean baseline.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.summary: AIDE recorded 1,703 entries and the finalized baseline reported no differences.
AIDE reported the temporary `/etc/aide/.integrity-probe` as an added file and returned its change-detected status.

evidence.requirement: Persistent automated checks and protected baseline
evidence.summary: Shows the `/etc` policy, root:root mode-0600 database, successful check service, and enabled active daily timer.
Captured boot ID 88feca03-aee0-475e-8197-2863fc8b7651, running system state, active timer, and clean AIDE result.
Native safe reboot was scheduled and acknowledged before disconnection.
After recovery, boot ID changed to e90d6e9f-e58a-4892-a338-f8949584d762.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered services and data
evidence.summary: System returned to running; the timer remained enabled and active, the database persisted, and AIDE reported no differences across all 1,703 entries.
